source_gate: Only fixed L3 or matched-basis checkpoints with source-validation CE gain >=0.3; N2 must be compared against learned N1
new_controlled_held_views: Reobserve 256 independent source-validation SED instances through full CLAUDS-like curves and strictly new UV/NIR curves, without source HSC/Legacy bands in the latter
matched_physics: Use exact saved FSPS mixtures, verified kernel and same 1% nominal errors; include NNLS template-only baseline
mismatched_physics: Use saved L3 analytic source parameters and new Gaussian realizations; template mismatch kept explicit
bootstrap: 300 paired bootstrap replicates over SED groups, including all repeated views per sampled SED; report N2 minus N1 outlier change
original_strict_Stage1_sets: Remain frozen; L4 models evaluated only if their original source-validation CE improves>=0.3 and selected update>0
